title: Murkglider Hivequeen
summary: Manage the Hivequeen's recurring eggs before their hatchlings overwhelm the group.
overview: Manage the Hivequeen's recurring eggs before their hatchlings overwhelm the group.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign egg and hatchling control and avoid allowing successive waves to accumulate.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Every forty seconds in combat, the Hivequeen lays three quivering eggs.
After thirty seconds, each egg produces two murk hatchlings.
A repeating hate check draws idle hatchlings and murkglider attendants into her fight.
Disengagement stops new egg waves and the hate-link timer.

notes: Approval E399. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Egg and hatchling template IDs are verified; the Hivequeen template still needs database confirmation.
